# Intrinsicism

> The portfolio of Daci (Dacian) Scurtu, a creative director specialising in web design, based in Valencia, Spain. A scroll-driven, immersive site about creative direction and the shift from pursuing success to understanding purpose. Founded 2026.

The site is a single page at https://daciscurtu.com/ with four sections: Manifesto, Projects, About and Contact.

## About
- Daci Scurtu is a business student, a footballer and a creative director specialising in web design.
- Practices: creative direction, brand direction, web design, interactive design. Disciplines: art direction, UX and UI design, motion and interaction, front-end build.
- Has lived in Spain, England and Australia.

## Projects
- ONPOINT (2024): his own streetwear accessories label. Brand identity, print, product and film.
- Forma (2026): a concept website for an architecture and design studio. https://daci-s.github.io/Forma-version-2/
- Elara & Co (2026): a concept website for a wedding photography and film studio. https://daci-s.github.io/Elara-co/
- Clerestory (2026): a concept website for a stained-glass studio in York. https://daci-s.github.io/Clerestory/
- Isochrone (2026): a concept website for a watch manufacture. https://daci-s.github.io/Isochrone/
- The Descent (2026): a scroll-driven dive to the bottom of the sea.

## Availability
- Open to internships, freelance projects, mentorship and collaborations with agencies, studios or brands.
- Works with young and upcoming brands, businesses, athletes, entrepreneurs, models and personalities.
